_comment: Authoritative reference links the consulting deliverable cites so the client can verify compliance claims.

HIPAA.title: HIPAA — U.S. Dept. of Health & Human Services
HIPAA.note: Federal standard governing the protection of Protected Health Information (PHI). Requires administrative, physical, and technical safeguards; on-prem deployment keeps PHI inside the covered entity's control boundary.

SOC2-Type-II.title: AICPA SOC 2 — Trust Services Criteria
SOC2-Type-II.note: Independent attestation of a vendor's controls for security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy over a period of time (Type II).

US.title: Data residency — keeping data within the United States
US.note: All primary storage, backups, and telemetry must remain within US jurisdiction to satisfy the residency constraint.

frameworks.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
frameworks.note: Voluntary framework for managing risks of AI systems across govern, map, measure, and manage functions — the backbone of the governance plan below.

frameworks.title: NIST SP 800-53 — Security & Privacy Controls
frameworks.note: Control catalog used to harden on-prem deployments handling sensitive data.
